All 7 test cases pass, and `go build`/`go vet` are clean.

What I implemented in `bottle_song.go`:

- **`numberWords`** — a map of counts 0–10 to lowercase English words (`0` → `"no"`, `1` → `"one"`, … `10` → `"ten"`), since the last line uses `"no"` and the first line needs a capitalized form.
- **`bottleWord(n)`** — handles the singular/plural quirk: `1` → `"bottle"`, everything else (including `0`) → `"bottles"`.
- **`titleCase(s)`** — a small helper that uppercases the first letter, used for the verse-opening lines (`"Ten green bottles…"`) so the solution doesn't depend on the deprecated `strings.Title` or the test-only `Title` helper in `bottle_song_test.go` (defining it in the solution would have collided with the test file's copy).
- **`verse(n)`** — builds the four lines of the verse for `n` bottles, including the `"There'll be …"` line for `n-1`.
- **`Recite(startBottles, takeDown)`** — emits `takeDown` consecutive verses starting at `startBottles`, inserting a single empty string between verses.

No other files were modified.
